catalog_scope: Named declarations in the selected eight-file profile. Anonymous instances and examples remain available in complete source, outside the named catalog.

claims.condition: The relation and seeds are supplied inputs, and the certificate check must succeed. This illustration is not a newly executed fixture or a proof that a source dependency was declared correctly.
claims.summary: If the declared relation is A → B → C, selecting A requires all three. A successful finite certificate establishes the exact reachable set, including the seeds, and its leastness among seed-containing closed sets.
claims.title: Selecting A also retains required B and unresolved C

claims.condition: This theorem assumes a well-formed model and a successful certificate check; the budget counts local records.
claims.summary: When the required closure has three records, a budget of two produces refusal. The operation cannot claim success by truncating a required record.
claims.title: A budget of two cannot silently return only A and B

claims.condition: Equality preserves the recorded content; it does not establish authority legitimacy or the truth of a predicate.
claims.summary: A selected record is the original record, with its owner, scope, context, basis and payload intact. The projection also retains its parent coordinates.
claims.title: Keep the complete record, not just its label

claims.condition: The theorem preserves recorded residuals; it cannot discover an uncertainty missing from the source model.
claims.summary: Every original residual is accounted for as an exact retained unresolved record or a named excluded residual. Projection does not resolve the uncertainty.
claims.title: An open question stays visible

declarations.name: Dependencies
declarations.statement: abbrev Dependencies

declarations.name: Reachable
declarations.statement: def Reachable (d : Dependencies) (seeds : Finset Nat) (x : Nat) : Prop

declarations.name: Closed
declarations.statement: def Closed (d : Dependencies) (s : Finset Nat) : Prop

declarations.name: traceSet
declarations.statement:
def traceSet (known : Finset Nat) : List Nat → Finset Nat
  | [] => known
  | x :: rest => traceSet (insert x known) rest

declarations.name: Witness
declarations.statement:
def Witness (d : Dependencies) (known : Finset Nat) : List Nat → Prop
  | [] => True
  | x :: rest => (∃ parent ∈ known, x ∈ d parent) ∧ Witness d (insert x known) rest

declarations.name: witnessDecidable
declarations.statement:
instance witnessDecidable (d : Dependencies) (known : Finset Nat) (trace : List Nat) :
    Decidable (Witness d known trace)

declarations.name: CertificateValid
declarations.statement: def CertificateValid (d : Dependencies) (universeKeys seeds : Finset Nat) (trace : List Nat) : Prop

declarations.name: checkCertificate
declarations.statement: def checkCertificate (d : Dependencies) (universeKeys seeds : Finset Nat) (trace : List Nat) : Bool

declarations.name: checkCertificate_valid
declarations.statement:
theorem checkCertificate_valid (d : Dependencies) (universeKeys seeds : Finset Nat)
    (trace : List Nat) (h : checkCertificate d universeKeys seeds trace = true) :
    CertificateValid d universeKeys seeds trace

declarations.name: seed_reachable
declarations.statement:
theorem seed_reachable (d : Dependencies) (seeds : Finset Nat) {x : Nat}
    (h : x ∈ seeds) : Reachable d seeds x

declarations.name: reachable_step
declarations.statement:
theorem reachable_step (d : Dependencies) (seeds : Finset Nat) {x y : Nat}
    (h : Reachable d seeds x) (edge : y ∈ d x) : Reachable d seeds y

declarations.name: known_subset_traceSet
declarations.statement:
theorem known_subset_traceSet (known : Finset Nat) (trace : List Nat) :
    known ⊆ traceSet known trace

declarations.name: witness_reachable
declarations.statement:
theorem witness_reachable (d : Dependencies) (seeds known : Finset Nat) (trace : List Nat)
    (base : ∀ x ∈ known, Reachable d seeds x) (witness : Witness d known trace) :
    ∀ x ∈ traceSet known trace, Reachable d seeds x

declarations.name: reachable_in_closed
certificate_exact_reachability
declarations.statement:
theorem certificate_exact_reachability (d : Dependencies) (universeKeys seeds : Finset Nat)
    (trace : List Nat) (checked : checkCertificate d universeKeys seeds trace = true) (x : Nat) :
    x ∈ traceSet seeds trace ↔ Reachable d seeds x

declarations.name: certificate_seed_inclusion
declarations.statement:
theorem certificate_seed_inclusion (d : Dependencies) (universeKeys seeds : Finset Nat)
    (trace : List Nat) (_checked : checkCertificate d universeKeys seeds trace = true) :
    seeds ⊆ traceSet seeds trace

declarations.name: certificate_closed
declarations.statement:
theorem certificate_closed (d : Dependencies) (universeKeys seeds : Finset Nat)
    (trace : List Nat) (checked : checkCertificate d universeKeys seeds trace = true) :
    Closed d (traceSet seeds trace)

declarations.name: certificate_least
declarations.statement:
theorem certificate_least (d : Dependencies) (universeKeys seeds : Finset Nat)
    (trace : List Nat) (checked : checkCertificate d universeKeys seeds trace = true)
    (candidate : Finset Nat) (includeSeeds : seeds ⊆ candidate) (closed : Closed d candidate) :
    traceSet seeds trace ⊆ candidate

declarations.name: certificate_fixed_point
declarations.statement:
theorem certificate_fixed_point (d : Dependencies) (universeKeys seeds : Finset Nat)
    (trace : List Nat) (checked : checkCertificate d universeKeys seeds trace = true) (x : Nat) :
    x ∈ traceSet seeds trace ↔
      x ∈ seeds ∨ ∃ parent ∈ traceSet seeds trace, x ∈ d parent

declarations.name: certificate_unique
declarations.statement:
theorem certificate_unique (d : Dependencies) (universeKeys seeds : Finset Nat)
    (left right : List Nat)
    (hl : checkCertificate d universeKeys seeds left = true)
    (hr : checkCertificate d universeKeys seeds right = true) :
    traceSet seeds left = traceSet seeds right

inductive Family where
  | objects | relations | constraints | latitude | residuals
  | traversals | transformations | judgments

declarations.name: Record
declarations.statement:
structure Record where
  key : Nat
  identity : String
  family : Family
  context : String
  owner : String
  scope : String
  basis : String
  payload : String
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

declarations.name: Target
declarations.statement:
inductive Target where
  | localRecord (key : Nat)
  | external (identity : String)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

declarations.name: PathStep
declarations.statement:
inductive PathStep where
  | field (name : String)
  | index (position : Nat)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

declarations.name: Reference
declarations.statement:
structure Reference where
  owner : Nat
  path : List PathStep
  target : Target
  governing : Bool
  domain : String
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

declarations.name: External
declarations.statement:
structure External where
  identity : String
  payload : String
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

declarations.name: Model
declarations.statement:
structure Model where
  identity : String
  rawSha256 : String
  canonicalSha256 : String
  envelope : String
  records : List Record
  references : List Reference
  externalResolutions : List External
  edges : List (Nat × Nat)
  invalidation : String
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

declarations.statement: def Model.dependencies (m : Model) (key : Nat) : Finset Nat

declarations.name: Target.Resolves
declarations.statement:
def Target.Resolves (keys : Finset Nat) (external : List String) : Target → Prop
  | .localRecord key => key ∈ keys
  | .external name => name ∈ external

declarations.statement: def Model.WellFormed (m : Model) : Prop

declarations.statement: def checkModel (m : Model) : Bool

declarations.statement: theorem checkModel_sound (m : Model) (h : checkModel m = true) : m.WellFormed

declarations.statement: def retained (m : Model) (selected : Finset Nat) : List Record

declarations.name: retained_iff
declarations.statement:
theorem retained_iff (m : Model) (selected : Finset Nat) (r : Record) :
    r ∈ retained m selected ↔ r ∈ m.records ∧ r.key ∈ selected

declarations.name: Projection
declarations.statement:
structure Projection where
  parentIdentity : String
  parentRawSha256 : String
  parentCanonicalSha256 : String
  parentEnvelope : String
  seeds : Finset Nat
  included : Finset Nat
  excluded : Finset Nat
  records : List Record
  external : List External
  ordinary : List Reference
  unresolved : List Record
  excludedResiduals : List Record
  invalidation : String

declarations.name: makeProjection
declarations.statement:
def makeProjection (m : Model) (seeds selected : Finset Nat) : Projection where
  parentIdentity

declarations.name: project
declarations.statement:
def project (m : Model) (seeds : Finset Nat) (trace : List Nat) (budget : Nat) :
    Except String Projection

declarations.name: projection_success
declarations.statement:
theorem projection_success (m : Model) (seeds : Finset Nat) (trace : List Nat) (budget : Nat)
    (modelChecked : checkModel m = true)
    (closureChecked : checkCertificate m.dependencies m.localKeys seeds trace = true)
    (fits : (traceSet seeds trace).card ≤ budget) :
    project m seeds trace budget = .ok (makeProjection m seeds (traceSet seeds trace))

declarations.name: project_ok_properties
declarations.statement:
theorem project_ok_properties (m : Model) (seeds : Finset Nat) (trace : List Nat)
    (budget : Nat) (p : Projection) (result : project m seeds trace budget = .ok p) :
    checkModel m = true ∧
    checkCertificate m.dependencies m.localKeys seeds trace = true ∧
    (traceSet seeds trace).card ≤ budget ∧
    p = makeProjection m seeds (traceSet seeds trace)

declarations.name: project_ok_exact_reachability
declarations.statement:
theorem project_ok_exact_reachability (m : Model) (seeds : Finset Nat) (trace : List Nat)
    (budget : Nat) (p : Projection) (result : project m seeds trace budget = .ok p)
    (x : Nat) : x ∈ p.included ↔ Reachable m.dependencies seeds x

declarations.name: insufficient_budget_refuses
declarations.statement:
theorem insufficient_budget_refuses (m : Model) (seeds : Finset Nat) (trace : List Nat) (budget : Nat)
    (modelChecked : checkModel m = true)
    (closureChecked : checkCertificate m.dependencies m.localKeys seeds trace = true)
    (insufficient : budget < (traceSet seeds trace).card) :
    project m seeds trace budget =
      .error "insufficient record budget; required closure is not truncated"

declarations.name: projection_record_conservation
declarations.statement:
theorem projection_record_conservation (m : Model) (seeds selected : Finset Nat) (r : Record) :
    r ∈ (makeProjection m seeds selected).records ↔ r ∈ m.records ∧ r.key ∈ selected

declarations.name: projection_authority_basis_conservation
declarations.statement:
theorem projection_authority_basis_conservation (m : Model) (seeds selected : Finset Nat)
    (r : Record) (h : r ∈ (makeProjection m seeds selected).records) :
    ∃ original ∈ m.records, original = r ∧ original.owner = r.owner ∧
      original.scope = r.scope ∧ original.context = r.context ∧ original.basis = r.basis ∧
      original.payload = r.payload

declarations.name: projection_residual_conservation
declarations.statement:
theorem projection_residual_conservation (m : Model) (seeds selected : Finset Nat) (r : Record) :
    r ∈ (makeProjection m seeds selected).unresolved ↔
      r ∈ m.records ∧ r.key ∈ selected ∧ r.family = .residuals

declarations.name: projection_excluded_exact
declarations.statement:
theorem projection_excluded_exact (m : Model) (seeds selected : Finset Nat) (x : Nat) :
    x ∈ (makeProjection m seeds selected).excluded ↔ x ∈ m.localKeys ∧ x ∉ selected

declarations.name: projection_external_exact
declarations.statement:
theorem projection_external_exact (m : Model) (seeds selected : Finset Nat) (e : External) :
    e ∈ (makeProjection m seeds selected).external ↔
      e ∈ m.externalResolutions ∧ ∃ ref ∈ m.references,
        ref.owner ∈ selected ∧ ref.target = .external e.identity

declarations.name: projection_ordinary_exact
declarations.statement:
theorem projection_ordinary_exact (m : Model) (seeds selected : Finset Nat) (ref : Reference) :
    ref ∈ (makeProjection m seeds selected).ordinary ↔
      ref ∈ m.references ∧ ref.owner ∈ selected ∧
        ∃ key, ref.target = .localRecord key ∧ key ∉ selected

declarations.name: projection_excluded_residual_exact
declarations.statement:
theorem projection_excluded_residual_exact (m : Model) (seeds selected : Finset Nat)
    (r : Record) :
    r ∈ (makeProjection m seeds selected).excludedResiduals ↔
      r ∈ m.records ∧ r.key ∉ selected ∧ r.family = .residuals

declarations.name: projection_all_residuals_accounted
declarations.statement:
theorem projection_all_residuals_accounted (m : Model) (seeds selected : Finset Nat)
    (r : Record) (original : r ∈ m.records) (residual : r.family = .residuals) :
    r ∈ (makeProjection m seeds selected).unresolved ∨
      r ∈ (makeProjection m seeds selected).excludedResiduals

declarations.name: projection_parent_conservation
declarations.statement:
theorem projection_parent_conservation (m : Model) (seeds selected : Finset Nat) :
    (makeProjection m seeds selected).parentIdentity = m.identity ∧
    (makeProjection m seeds selected).parentRawSha256 = m.rawSha256 ∧
    (makeProjection m seeds selected).parentCanonicalSha256 = m.canonicalSha256 ∧
    (makeProjection m seeds selected).parentEnvelope = m.envelope ∧
    (makeProjection m seeds selected).invalidation = m.invalidation
